snippet.title: MuteX+ Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Early Access available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504980/MuteX/

Technically the Early Access has been out for a couple months, but I never really gave it the proper marketing. Since then, so many things about the game have been improved, and I plan to continue that trend.
